pair_exact: vulnerable member flagged and control member not flagged
lane_completion: metrics exist only when all 112 eligible attempts complete with adapter-valid evidence
unsupported_lane: explicit unsupported state with null metrics and zero attempts
failed_attempt: preserved as failed evidence; no retry and no imputed finding count

comparisons.same_lane: paired binary decisions and absolute metric differences
comparisons.cross_lane: unavailable; native and capability-normalized lanes are not equivalent

timing: descriptive process evidence, excluded from detection quality
